scope: Preserve acknowledged solo-earned personal data and exact compatible campaign continuity on return to co-op, and establish that continuity for a new independently matched solo import. Keep divergent or unproven sources protected. Includes narrow connection cleanup and temporary-role/dependent ownership corrections discovered by the actual return path.
production_policy: Only an inactive unique tally with a positive same-SID acknowledgement at least as new as the host can replace an existing reserved personal hero/purse. A restored older host may legitimately see the normal final goodbye package N+1; resume sequence monotonically. Different-name U26 alias migration still requires exact latest sequence.

An acknowledged new personal baseline replaces hero_in, orig_name, purse and private party context; clears stale context_checkpoint and personal companion markers; authored body changes use the ordinary late-join spawn path. Same-body reuse refreshes the existing orphan actor metadata/model.

Both a rebased existing participant and a new solo source can be clean/present at arrival only when current zone, authored active party/protagonist and bidirectional nonexcluded story variables, side quests and quest items match. No host story is copied to force a match.
Zone re-entry/load repeats the story compatibility guard before granting full checkpoint eligibility, so a rejected behind/conflicting source cannot become eligible merely because it visited the map.

A bring-save deploys its main hero. Incoming personal pets and optional base hires remain private in its solo save; only that inactive owner's obsolete live copies are retired with existing removal/dismissal bookkeeping. Other owners and LiA authored/shared companion roles remain intact.

For matching temporary authored roles, restore only sanitized matching protagonist rows and bags inside the inspected seeded hierarchy. Preserve host deployment identity and location/body fields, own role earnings and separately parked main-protagonist earnings. Never deploy raw private context.

Active same-name transport replacement remembers activity before retiring the previous connection, so it cannot import altered personal data over a live participant. SceneMultiplayer.disconnect_peer removes transport and high-level peer/path ownership; explicit co-op and Session departure handlers run once because that API suppresses the signal.

actual_data_and_path.chapter: Parse original LiA maps/bz1h.mob party instructions to prepare FPrison; actual host/guest body becomes Hero1. Discover gz1h actual mob alias zone1 via campaign metadata, then authored quest q.gz1h.q01h.
actual_data_and_path.shared_progression: Normal GSSetVar dispatch advances q.gz1h.q01h from 1 to 2. Extract the original bz1h LeaveToZone(0,"gz1h",1) call and tick original VM. Ann and Fresh have no fabricated gz1h visited/unlock flag; both receive their own completed quest and shared FPrison/gz1h checkpoint.
actual_data_and_path.network: Normal MainMenu character selection and Join/confirmed Exit input, independent SceneMultiplayer frontends over real loopback ENet in one process, host save/package RPC, original scene loads; fresh separate process then offline-loads only the actual received personal saves.
actual_data_and_path.fresh_slot_note: Fresh is slot 6 because four deliberately distinct negative-control participants retain their own reserved slots 2-5; these are not rename ghosts.

baseline.candidate_comparison: The matching first 30 assertions pass in sreturn-final-main (94 total).

crash_and_transport_diagnosis.fixture_crash: The old common leave helper captured last_merged before normal leave. On the active replacement's first join no package had arrived yet, so the fixture loaded an empty save slot and passed null to typed main_hero. Matching-symbol GDB stopped in Array::is_empty through a GDScript static call. The corrected fixture waits for the normal delivered host-save package before leave and asserts loaded source nonnull. No runtime patch or unrelated native-exit fix is claimed.
crash_and_transport_diagnosis.real_transport_defect: Separately, ENetPacketPeer.peer_disconnect_now cleared a raw peer while ENetMultiplayerPeer still retained it; later broadcast produced four null-peer send errors. The public SceneMultiplayer disconnect API removes high-level peer/path plus transport state. Final active-copy test observes unchanged live actor/purse, no old peer, exactly two players_changed notifications (one departure, one replacement join), and no logged errors.
crash_and_transport_diagnosis.refcounted_fixture_hygiene: ScriptVM is RefCounted. advance_solo clears its reciprocal world reference and releases the local reference with null; it does not call free on a retained RefCounted.

fixture_delta_notes: The committed main fixture adds only optional --rebase-only early completion after the first 30 assertions; the full default path is unchanged from final fixture20. Baseline fixture21 uses that option and a separate game port 29948. All other owned test files match final fixture20.

peer_dependency_note.difference: Only equivalent line wrapping of _actor_calls condition in committed 74c4804; peer separately verified 36 formatting checks. Our three production files and the VM restore hook match candidate05 byte-for-byte. Parent will perform the final combined frozen-source integration run.

limits: Compatibility deliberately requires equality of all nonexcluded authored variables, not only the visible quest journal. Random/nonquest state such as LiA rchest can make independently played same-quest saves incompatible. Unknown authored flags are not silently discarded.
The fixture prepares matched independently played story states explicitly and executes original party/transfer instructions. This is not a full multi-hour campaign or every quest branch playthrough.
Only the protagonist is deployed by a brought source; personal pets/base hires remain in the player's solo save. LiA shared authored companions retain host authority.

New role/dependent controls use original authored role operations plus focused constructed mutable records and GameWorld registry actors; they are not a full pet-taming or companion-hiring playthrough.
No repair of arbitrary old or incomplete saves is claimed. This fixes forward sync and supported reimport paths; missing history is not reconstructed.

All final checks are headless. Live host/guest original EIUnitModel/body metadata is verified, but no new visual screenshot acceptance is claimed. Prior U26 rendered evidence remains a separate receipt.
The actual transport is local ENet with independent frontends in one process. No internet, Windows, handheld, packet-loss or sustained timing/performance acceptance is claimed.
Test durations are descriptive and not performance measurements. Earlier incomplete, crashing and setup-error runs are retained above and excluded from the 803 accepted checks.
Only disposable profiles/private exports were used. Existing public builds, user saves and selected personal fixture files were not overwritten.
